All over Australia.

Change the Government, change the rules.
We’re out and about to #ChangeTheRules and change the Government.
Sally McManus addressing our inaugural National Conference
Michaelia Cash attacks workers, and we pay for it.
Just a few people in Melbourne here to #ChangeTheRules

A new directive issued by Malcolm Turnbull's union-busting ABCC has warned of more stringent controls on union material on federal Government jobs - including employees wearing anything that features the Eureka Flag. 
This flag represents our struggle, and we stand united beneath it.
Fantastic speech from @billshortenmp at the National Press Club today. We need a real living wage.
Yesterday marked 200 days that our members at Oaky North have been locked out of their work place. We're standing with them to fight back.

Glencore locked out our members at #OakyNorth, simply for asking to keep conditions that they already had. Glencore wants more casuals and contractors, they want to destroy the town of Tieri.
While our members are locked out, they spend their days helping out the local kindergarten.
Tune in to CFMEU on Facebook now to watch Tony Maher, Sally McManus and Michael O'Connor talk about Glencore's corporate greed #OakyNorth
#OakyNorth CFMEU members are fighting for a fair go from Glencore.
